title: Kissed Silky Russian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Russian stew featuring lamb, harissa spice, and tadka, with a rich and silky texture, perfect for a cold monsoon day. This low-sodium dish is sure to warm your senses.
instructions: Heat the tadka oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the harissa spice and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Pour in the low-sodium beef broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
